features: Wireless Connectivity: Using the latest wireless technology, the Portronics Toad IV wireless mouse can connect to your devices wirelessly using the 2.4 GHz USB receiver or Bluetooth. Enjoy a working range of up to 10 metres.

Triple Device Pairing: Pair the mouse with up to 3 devices at one time, one using the 2.4 GHz USB receiver, and the other two using Bluetooth. It is compatible with Laptop, PC, Mac, Tablets, and Smartphones.

Type-C Charging: This wireless mouse has a long battery life. You can charge it using the included Type-C Charging Cable. Connect the Type C end of the cable to the mouse’s charging port and the other end to any compatible power source.

Silent Clicks: Features silent clicks so that you can work quietly, and eliminate noise and distractions for yourself and others around you, especially while working at night. It is ideal for use at -home, office, library, & other places.
Colorful RGB Lights: The wireless optical mouse comes with Dynamic RGB Lights with 2 modes. You can easily switch between them and enjoy an enhanced working experience.
description: Introducing the Portronics Toad IV, a wireless mouse designed to elevate your computing experience. Harness the latest wireless technology through its 2.4 GHz USB receiver or Bluetooth connectivity, granting you the freedom to connect effortlessly within a 10-meter range. This versatile mouse supports triple device pairing, accommodating your laptop, PC, Mac, tablets, and smartphones simultaneously. With a Type-C charging capability, the mouse ensures a prolonged battery life, easily rechargeable through the included cable. Work discreetly with silent clicks, perfect for quiet environments, while the mouse's colorful RGB lights in two dynamic modes enhance your workspace ambiance. The ambidextrous design caters to both left and right-handed users, boasting an extended 50 lakhs+ click life. Customize your precision with the 3-level adjustable optical DPI (800/1200/1600), ensuring accurate cursor movement for diverse tasks. Additionally, the mouse features an auto power-saving mode, entering sleep mode after 10 minutes of inactivity, preserving energy and prolonging battery life.
